name: Technique title · heat and impact
intent: Make a fire-technique title feel connected to its spoken name and pictured action.
when_to_use: A verified fire/heat technique quote with an identified impact frame.
avoid: Applying fire to unrelated techniques; hiding faces; revealing a technique before its line; default plain subtitle styling.
steps: Verify the complete phrase, speaker, technique and source-frame ownership before designing type.
Choose and verify an installed expressive font; keep the text editable and readable against the actual shot.
Build a restrained ember/heat edge and luminance-driven reveal timed to the spoken syllables; keep optional motion treatments separately editable.
Place the strongest expansion/flash at the pictured technique impact, then clear the frame for its follow-through.
Render a short proof and inspect exact type bounds, syllable timing, bright/dark readability and the next cut; adjust to this footage.

parameters.font: Must be chosen and verified for the shot
parameters.intensity: Tune from proof, not a fixed universal setting

limits: Candidate procedure only. Requires genuine visual/sound review and Tony approval; no preapproved outcome or generated finished scene.

name: Wide-to-face motivated match zoom
intent: Bridge a wide shot into a compatible face close-up with one intentional deep zoom.
when_to_use: Both original shots have verified compatible face orientation, position and action direction.
avoid: Blind center zooms, framing guesses, duplicated scale/null owners, cut-off heads, reused finished transitions.
steps: Measure the face anchor and intended cut frame in both source shots; reject mismatched identity/orientation.
Use one clearly owned added-zoom treatment for the shot, retaining any deliberate source retime as a separate owner.
Design a deep approach into the face with an easing curve motivated by the music and action; match the close-up scale/anchor at the cut.
Inspect dense boundary frames for black edges, face jumps and overshoot; preserve original handles.
Review normal-speed motion before accepting the transition and record the useful parameter bounds for this pair.

parameters.duration: Chosen from the actual musical phrase

limits: A recipe cannot prove a facial match or smooth playback; source-specific measurement and final review remain required.

name: Complete quote with source-action sound
intent: Keep one complete speaker-owned quote and restore original impact sounds without unwanted anime score.
when_to_use: Verified original audio or separated stems and a frame-native picture plan are available.
avoid: Overlapping unrelated speakers, music-only clashes, truncated phrases and a silent final scene.
steps: Locate the whole phrase and its matching speaker/shot chain; retain word and breath handles.
Separate or select source voice/effects using the installed local capability; never claim score removal when no suitable source/stem exists.
Map source effects through the same retime as picture and place the contact/impact at its actual frame.
Shape music ducks around speech and impacts, keep the intended song ending through the final picture, and maintain separately editable audio layers.
Measure peaks, decode, alignment and ending audio locally; disclose that leakage/cleanliness/action feel still requires listening.

parameters.duck: Set from the measured mix and review
parameters.ending: Full musical phrase through the picture ending

limits: Numeric checks are not listening; this candidate needs source-specific proof and Tony’s approval.
